budgetPolicy.source: Fresh verified available native USDC balance, excluding existing reservations
budgetPolicy.calculation: For each buy, floor(available native atomic units * spendPercent / 100 / 1e12) in ERC-20 USDC atomic units: Personal2 95%, Personal4 50%, Personal5 52%.
budgetPolicy.gas: The unspent balance (Personal2 5%, Personal4 50%, Personal5 48%) must cover all approvals and swap gas. Stop before signing if insufficient; do not exceed each wallet's requested percentage trade budget.

executionConstraints: No transactions, approvals, signing or broadcasts before the later go-ahead.
Use the actual confirmed token address, not ticker resolution or a prediction alone.
Reuse verified pool identity; refresh price and simulation. Account for earlier buy price impact when preparing Personal4 and Personal5.
Submission order is controlled; block execution order across independent wallets is not guaranteed.
Required router/Permit2 allowances must be verified before each dependent swap. Approval requirements can prevent immediate back-to-back swap broadcasts; establish the preparation path beforehand.
Keep quote minimum output and slippage bounds. Do not silently raise slippage to force any buy through.
Use durable per-wallet jobs and idempotent signing/broadcast recovery.
